findings.observation: The sole-call render remains unmistakably Aden: one mature adult woman with the same deepest skin band, round full face, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow and notch, long straight nose, narrow upper lip, and restrained closed-mouth expression.

Her exceptional but coherent bodybuilder construction remains specific: very broad shoulders and torso, enormous defined muscle mass, thick legs, and a compact grounded posture without generic soft-body inflation.
Upper arms and forearms retain Aden’s exceptional muscular girth; wrists and empty clenched hands remain coherent with the source rather than receiving generic mitten-like inflation.
The brown-chestnut curls-and-coils halo, high gathered coil mass, swept front construction, side silhouette, and loose tendrils closely preserve the verified summon source.

The oxblood-navy repaired tailored longcoat, broad quilted collar, readable waist, split divided hem, plain underlayer, fitted shoes, contrasting laces, bracelet stack, and cord details are preserved, but an undeclared gold hoop earring was reintroduced on the exposed ear even though the corrected summon source has a bare ear and the prompt says add nothing new.

Original-resolution bounding inspection estimates the complete hair-top-to-chin unit at roughly 37 percent of hair-top-to-sole standing height, about 2.7 heads tall; this is slightly above the frozen 32–36 percent range and below the required 2.75-head minimum.
Exactly one subject is present, and the entire high coil halo, head, both empty hands, split coat hem, both legs, both shoes, and grounding shadow remain fully inside generous canvas margins.
The broad planted stance, compact silhouette, forward three-quarter orientation, bent empty arms, and clenched empty hands read clearly as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The image remains an ordinary mortal in visibly mended cloth tailoring with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, affinity cue, aura, glow, supernatural effect, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
